p: Queensway is Bletchley's main shopping street, and MERKUR here is a short walk from the Brunel Centre and from Bletchley station on the West Coast Main Line. It's an over-18s venue, strictly adults.

Bletchley's big draw is, of course, Bletchley Park, the home of the Second World War codebreakers, with restored huts, exhibitions and the story of Alan Turing and the team who cracked Enigma. Right next door is The National Museum of Computing, home to rebuilt wartime machines including Colossus. Both are easy walks from the station, so you can make a proper day of it.
